notes: Codex threads get an Ultrafast toggle beside Fast, offered only when the logged-in codex account reports the tier. Plumbing: SessionMeta, the user-text stamp, the sessions table (new `ultrafast` column, defaulted 0), session.tune, the codex driver (thread config `service_tier: 'ultrafast'`, else 'priority' for fast, else none), the renderer store sync, create-time tune, Composer retune, the fold stamp and the turn meta line ("Ultrafast" else "Fast") all mirror the existing fast knob; fast and ultrafast are one service-tier knob, so turning either on turns the other off on both the server (sessions.tune) and in ModelSettings. Detection: codexTiers.ts (main) spawns the installed codex app-server once at boot, runs initialize → model/list → account/read, records each model's serviceTiers under the account email in the settings key `codex.speedTiers`, stamps `speedTiers` onto the matching CATALOG.codex rows (and clears it from rows the CLI did not list), and catalog.get waits for the first probe (8s cap) so the picker never shows a stale answer; the cached tiers for the last account are applied synchronously at boot, and `catalog.get {refresh:true}` reprobes. Renderer: codexSettings (catalog.ts) adds the Ultrafast toggle only when the model's speedTiers include "ultrafast"; a probed model without it keeps Fast alone with the tooltip "Ultrafast is not on this account"; an unprobed row (e.g. the Sol pair, which the installed 0.153.4 does not list) is unchanged. Nothing is assumed: on this machine codex 0.153.4 with landonhale123@gmail.com lists ['priority','ultrafast'] for gpt-6-astra and ['priority'] for gpt-5.6-sol/terra/luna, verified by a one-off vitest run of probeCodexTiers against the real binary. Limit: tiers come from the CLI's own login, not a thread's pinned gateway account. Tests: codexTiers.test.ts (model/list parsing, stamping and clearing, cache read), sessions-limits (exclusivity), store (ultrafast sync), catalog (toggle only when probed). Verified: typecheck, full vitest (2357), build.
